description.value: Goldie's Donuts & Bakery is a specialty brioche donut shop whose signature products are made using a 24-hour slow fermentation process inspired by Korean bakery traditions, yielding unusually light and flavourful results. The shop also offers creative signature drinks such as a Peanut Butter Cream Latte and Oreo Cream Mocha, designed to pair with the donuts. The Fraser Street location is one of five shops the brand operates across Metro Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 28m; rack (3 spaces) at 49m; stands (2 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces) at 70m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Location & Hours page confirms the Fraser St location at 3932 Fraser St, Vancouver V5V 4E4 with phone (236) 520-1444, matching the OSM record exactly. The website name consistently uses 'Goldie's Donuts & Bakery' (plural) while OSM has 'Goldie's Donut & Bakery' (singular) — a minor discrepancy flagged in concerns. No information about bike parking, water access, washrooms, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM has 'Goldie's Donut & Bakery' (singular) but the website consistently uses 'Goldie's Donuts & Bakery' (plural). The website form is likely authoritative.
Category mismatch: shop=bakery is mapped to Groceries, but this is a specialty donut café, not a general grocery store.
The online order page defaults to pickup at the Kitsilano location (2017 4th Ave W), not the Fraser St location — this is a UX quirk of the ordering system, not a location error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating multi-location bakery with confirmed Fraser St address, phone, and active online ordering. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates five locations across Metro Vancouver (West Vancouver/Horseshoe Bay, Langley, Fraser St Vancouver, North Vancouver, and Kitsilano). Each has its own phone number and email.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag shop=bakery maps to Groceries, but this is a specialty donut and bakery café, not a general grocery store. A Café or Food & Drink category would be more accurate.
